text: Head rewritten at D4a-01 (2,963 words by wc -w; links.py: all ids resolve; no bare stage ids): J after the D3c interview and QD4-001; the return and the tree (section 1, F01 and its five subforms, the cross-links, the accounting, where the pass stopped); the two held proposals stated with their moves, lines and rooms; the account with P05 as frozen, its bound held; the reasons for the last moves; the ledgers; the run stops after this leg.

D4a-01 closing; J stops the run after this leg (QD4-001). The model stands at the D3 freeze, 46384686, with the P05 bound and the A11 withdrawal held as proposals (moves 198 and 199, reverted by move 203). The first pass cut one element: F01, the play administered (103 rooms), and five subforms (F02 to F06), with 18 cross-links; 602 rooms are adapted but in no branch, each named in tree-D4.md. Working hypothesis: the ledger's form signals are weak (delta 0.4227, a chained dendrogram, no shared corrections below the bare target), and the branches it supports are elaborations of single elements; the next element to read would be restrict on P05 at T4-006 (59 rooms). validate.py D4: 0 errors, 1 warning (the comparison and projections, built after the final cut). Next: done.sh D4.

D4a-02 opened (25 October). Read AGENT.md, the head, STAGE-D4 (unchanged since D4a-01, 250 lines), diary --last 5, validate --open D4 (the same literal-pattern error on rooms-x-adaptations.<level>.<kind>.tsv; the sixteen matrices are present), and QD4-001's answer again. QD4-001 said J stops the run after D4a-01; the harness has opened D4a-02, so the run goes on, and this leg does the stage's work. Work that rested on my QD4-001 assumption (amendments left standing) was revisited at D4a-01: move 203 reverted them, the model is 46384686, and both are held proposals; nothing else rested on it. Plan: the second pass reads the 31 element change keys at level 4 left at D4a-01, by cut rules R0 to R7 (tree-D4.md), largest first, with subforms; then the cross-links, the accounting, the comparison (declared before it runs), the projections, the handback and the interview, and the close with done.sh D4 --cut interview, since J's credit limit makes this the last D4a leg if the work fits.

Cut rules, amendment R1a (D4a-02, 25 October; forward only, and F01 already meets it, since its largest child holds 37 of 103 rooms): where a level-4 change key's rooms are mostly one level-3 child (that child holds 80 per cent or more of them), the branch is declared at the third order on the child key, the deepest level where its members meet; otherwise at the fourth order, with children of 5 rooms or more as candidate subforms under R3. R1b: several change keys of one element whose rooms overlap are read together; where the same rooms carry two keys and their lines state one change, the branch takes both keys (a multi-key definition), otherwise each key is read on its own. R1c: a group whose lines restate a condition or step the element's statement already holds changes nothing and is set aside under R2, whatever kind the lines were ruled.

Second pass, the readings, logged before the cuts are written (each key's lines read whole in out/_analysis/d4a02_keys/, by d4_key_lines_bynode.py). Of the 31 element change keys at level 4 left at D4a-01, 23 pass R2 and are cut (with P12's child T3-117 cut alone), and 8 are set aside: add-condition on P05 at T4-013 (conditions of several kinds: members' time, stale display, repair keeping an alteration, upkeep of others' work); add-step on P02 at T4-006 (many design steps, most held by 'the room argues its design'); add-step on P05 at T4-013 (upkeep steps of several kinds, partly held by 'puts upkeep before growth'); add-step on P20 at T4-002 (finer forms of the megathread, removals and venues the statement holds); add-step on P12 at T4-027 (several steps; its child T3-117 cut on its own); add-condition on K01 at T4-001 (several conditions; 15 of its rooms in F01); add-condition on P08 at T4-016 (several conditions; the commonest, that a deal binds only placers who know it, held by P21 and A19); add-condition on P14 at T4-009 (mostly F08's change, the rest of several kinds). The cuts F07 to F35 (specs out/_analysis/d4a02_cut_F07.json to F35.json, by d4a02_specs.py): 24 top-level branches and 5 subforms (F12 to F14 under F11; F18 and F19 under F17). Three P05 restrict branches (F07 at the design, F26 at the border, F27 in keeping) state one limit of P05's added clause in three settings; they meet only at the bare target, a grouping under R4, so they stay three branches. F15 and F33 (P04, the plan kept current) and F22 and F28 (P16, help conditional) likewise state one change at two nodes. Two spec names were changed before writing, since the check matches a member's name inside a branch name (the room 'de' inside 'decisions' and 'outside'): F16 and F30.

move 208 (merging), D4a-02: branch F07 named at the fourth order, key restrict:P05:T4-006, 59 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the telling clause not shown at the design: informed members reject the planned change. What it changes: P05's added clause says that a planned change is repaired away until its keepers are told. In these rooms the lines limit the clause where the design is settled. About half say that members who know of the change reject it, so repair or recolouring enforces a competing design, and telling does not settle it. The others say the record does not show the untold keepers, the agreed change or the loss that the clause needs. The frozen clause holds here only in part. Ground: keys.

move 209 (merging), D4a-02: branch F08 named at the third order, key add-step:P14:T3-028, 50 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: machine hands kept on one target: installing, teaching and updating every runner. What it changes: P14 says the room adjusts its machine hands. In these rooms the adjusting is a step of its own: members install the script and teach it, and they keep every runner's target current, because a stale target undoes the room's own new design. A revision must reach the operator and the target file, not only the people. Ground: keys.

move 210 (merging), D4a-02: branch F09 named at the fourth order, key link:P03:T4-014, 54 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the move returns to building: relocation followed by renewed construction. What it changes: The model runs from building to keeping and, after a loss, to the move (P10), but no arrow runs from the move back to building. In these rooms it does: after a relocation the room recruits, designs and builds again at the new spot, and members report the new work. Ground: keys.

move 211 (merging), D4a-02: branch F10 named at the third order, key add-step:P08:T3-010, 38 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: a deal carried out as work: prepared in the room, then implemented and relayed. What it changes: P08 says rooms propose, settle and contest deals and hold each other to them. In these rooms a deal also takes work around it: members prepare it inside the room (local consensus, a contact, checks on the counterpart's credibility), and they carry it out by moving placed work, changing templates and bot targets, and relaying the terms to placers who do not know them. Ground: keys.

move 212 (merging), D4a-02: branch F11 named at the fourth order, key add-step:P13:T4-028, 43 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: carrying on as renewed work, begun before the close. What it changes: P13 says that near the close and after it the room decides what of its effort to keep. In these rooms carrying on is work in its own right, and it starts while placement is live: on another canvas the room recruits, builds and defends again, members remake the work in other media, and the mark is adopted into the room before the close. Ground: keys.

move 213 (splitting), D4a-02: subform F12 of F11 at the third order, key add-step:P13:T3-054, 22 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the spine restarted on another canvas. What it changes: Within F11, the room carries its work to a successor canvas, and there the spine runs again: recruiting, choosing a site, building, defending and losing work. Ground: keys.

move 214 (splitting), D4a-02: subform F13 of F11 at the third order, key add-step:P13:T3-057, 9 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the work remade in other media, often before the close. What it changes: Within F11, members remake the canvas work elsewhere (fan art, games, physical copies, a quoted text), and this often begins while the original is still live. Ground: keys.

move 215 (splitting), D4a-02: subform F14 of F11 at the third order, key add-step:P13:T3-156, 7 members (read from the level matrix by d4_cut.py). Name: the mark adopted as the room's emblem while it is still placed, damage included. What it changes: Within F11, the room takes the mark into its own sub (banner, flair, a room feature) during placement, and it may adopt the damaged form as fitting. Ground: keys.
